To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the online neighborhood forums have become a new social space in transitional urban China where homeowners of commodity housing have been using the Internet to mobilize and organize themselves for both the purchase of their homes and the management of the housing estates.

the online neighborhood forums have become a new platform for homeowners to organize collective actions, and the emergence of online neighborhood forums is closely linked to the homeowners’ collective actions.

the online neighborhood forums provide a new platform for the residents of commodity housing to interact with each other, to organize collective actions, and to build community in the context of the transitional urban China.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction between the Internet and the homeowners in the commodity housing estate, and the strategies of mobilizing the Internet for collective actions.
the emergence, content, functions and strategies of the online forums.
how the Internet is being used by the residents in the transitional urban China to improve their social position.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the neighborhood forum is a new social space in which the homeowners are able to organize themselves in a new way and in which the Internet plays a crucial role.
the Internet and the online neighborhood forums in particular have become a significant force in the process of the emergence of the homeowners as a social group.
the online neighborhood forums have become a new and important platform for the homeowners to interact with the Internet, with the government, and with other homeowners in their everyday lives.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Internet has become a powerful tool for the homeowners to improve their social and economic positions.
, in the context of transitional urban China, the Internet is not a mere tool to be adopted for the sake of efficiency.

the Internet has become an important part of the everyday life of the homeowners of the commodity housing estates in transitional urban China, and that the online and offline interactions have become an integral part of the everyday practices of the homeowners.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neighborhood forums are not only a new form of community, but they also have become the new platform for the homeowners to mobilize and organize themselves in the process of becoming homeowners.
the online neighborhood forums are not simply a tool for information dissemination, but also a platform for social interactions, community building, and collective action.
the Internet is not only an instrument of information dissemination and social interaction, but also an arena for social mobilization.
